Show HN: PatchWork – A 5-pass dedup pipeline to merge N resumes into one profile
items.snippet: I spent 4 months job searching with no callbacks. ChatGPT kept inventing stuff I never did. Teal and Rezi made me edit a base resume per job, which is what I was trying to skip. I built PatchWork instead. It takes everything you've ever written about your career, merges it into one profile, and generates a tailored resume per job description. The hard part was deduplication. The same accomplishment shows up across five resumes worded five different ways, and different metrics survive in different versions. If you just pick one as the winner, you throw away real information. Designed a 5-pass deduplication pipeline, combining deterministic code with AI to get it pretty close to right. A few of the messier cases: Umbrella entries. Some resumes list "2018 to 2022, Company X" as one block when it actually covers three different roles. The bullets have to get redistributed to the right titles before anything else happens. Bullet bleed. The same accomplishment ends up listed under different roles across different documents.
